question: I101 / I104 / I106
title: book300k hybrid scaling + order3/seqchoice regression: 1x+32k v47 ref vs 2x grown sheet + 32k / 2x + 64k chunk (granUtility=1, scaleInvariant=1, k 2968-2975)

accept.note: Paired per growth vs ref_1x_32k (k 2968-2975, same growth seed). ADOPT an arm (hybrid_2x_32k or hybrid_2x_64k_chunk) only if BOTH: (1) book300k: mean paired delta >= +0.004 AND delta > 0 on >= 6/8 growths; (2) no regression on the same 8 growths: paired mean delta on each of order3 (K8), K4, seqchoice order2, seqchoice cycle not worse than ref_1x_32k beyond its growth noise (proposed thresholds, not yet a repo convention: order3/K4 mean delta >= -0.01; seqchoice order2/cycle mean delta >= -0.02, sign of fewer than 6/8 growths worse). All arms run P.granFast=1: granFast is bit-identical (test_core I106) and with the gFast0 gate the >2048-granule layers use the faster sequential loop; P.granFast=2 would force the slower sparse-bitset path. Screen n 8; a winner needs a fresh 16-growth check before promotion in base.js.
